# Short description
In this experiment 7 different conditions — consisting of all possible combinations of *P. putida*, *B. subtilis* and a natural soil inoculum — were (co-)cultured in a well mixed environment (96-well-plate). Every 48 h the cultures were diluted 1:5 into fresh M9 media and further used as the new main culture. 
12 biological replicates. 
After the third cycle, cross-contamination between conditions and replicates was introduced and experiment was subsequently aborted. 

# Data Loading and Process Function


::: {.cell}

:::




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
process_plate <- function(file_path) {
  
  raw <- read_excel(file_path, col_names = FALSE)
  
  # Extract plate sections
  OD600  <- raw[37:44, 2:13]
  GFP70 <- raw[70:77, 2:13]
  RFP85 <- raw[103:110, 2:13]
  RFP90  <- raw[136:143, 2:13]
  
  # Convert to long format
  to_long <- function(df, name) {
    out <- as.data.frame(as.table(as.matrix(df)))
    out$wavelength <- name
    return(out)
  }
  
  OD600  <- to_long(OD600,  "OD600")
  GFP70 <- to_long(GFP70, "GFP70")
  RFP85 <- to_long(RFP85, "RFP85")
  RFP90  <- to_long(RFP90,  "RFP90")
  
  # Combine
  plate_concat <- rbindlist(list(OD600, GFP70, RFP85, RFP90))
  setnames(plate_concat, c("row", "col", "value", "wavelength"))
  
  plate_concat$value <- as.numeric(as.character(plate_concat$value))
  plate_concat$well <- paste0(plate_concat$row, plate_concat$col)
  
  # Date + time from same file
  date <- read_excel(file_path, range = "E6", col_names = FALSE)[[1]]
  time <- read_excel(file_path, range = "E7", col_names = FALSE)[[1]]
  
  plate_concat$datetime <- as.POSIXct(paste(date, time))
  
  # Conditions
  plate_concat$condition <- dplyr::recode(
    plate_concat$row,
    "A" = "Bs",
    "B" = "Bs+NI",
    "C" = "NI",
    "D" = "Bs+Pp+NI",
    "E" = "Bs+Pp",
    "F" = "Pp+NI",
    "G" = "Pp",
    "H" = "M9"
  )
  
  # Final tidy
  plate_concat <- plate_concat[, .(well, datetime, condition, wavelength, value)]
  
  return(plate_concat)
}
```
:::

files <- c(
  "008.0-PP BS Growth single point (Modified)_20260424_160703.xlsx",
  "008.1A-PP BS Growth single point (Modified)_20260424_160703.xlsx",
  "008.1B-PP BS Growth single point (Modified)_20260424_160703.xlsx",
  "008.2A-PP BS Growth single point (Modified)_20260424_160703.xlsx",
  "008.2B-PP BS Growth single point (Modified)_20260424_160703.xlsx",
  "008.3A-PP BS Growth single point_20260430_174232.xlsx",
  "008.3B-PP BS Growth single point_20260430_181943.xlsx",
  "008.4A-PP BS Growth single point_20260502_234619.xlsx",
  "008.4B-PP BS Growth single point_20260503_011632.xlsx"
